words.definition: A sudden, powerful movement forward or upward.
Will happen at some time, usually after a series of other events.
Able to move or be moved easily.
Firmly attached to something else or weighed down so it won't move easily.
The base pieces that houses and buildings are built on.
A group of things that are similar to each other in some way.
To watch something and see where it moves and how it changes.
To affect each other, or to work or play together.
To be put together or made up of different parts.
To have a connection or relationship between two things.
